source_note: Paper states the MBH1 seed has final mass 6e5 Msun and forms at z approximately 14.
Methods later associates approximate resulting BH masses 3e5 and 6e5 Msun with MBH1 and MBH2 respectively; retained separately rather than reconciled with the high-resolution MBH1 value.
Paper states the BH-accretion zoom starts when MBH2 forms at z=13.1; Methods associates MBH2 with an approximate 6e5 Msun resulting BH mass.
Accretion is several to a few tens times Eddington for less than 1 Myr; BH reaches several times 1e6 Msun shortly after formation.
After the early burst, accretion gradually decreases to 0.1-1 Eddington while BHs grow to >1e7 Msun by z approximately 10.
At z approximately 10 accretion sharply declines below 1 percent Eddington; masses are already >=1e7 Msun.
By z approximately 8 the massive BH system reaches about 3e7 Msun; after settling, accretion resumes at roughly 0.1-1 Eddington with a brief Eddington-level interval.
